g.text: No sign-up: each visitor gets a private, pre-seeded program, and every control runs the production code against real TablesDB rows.
every line is built from the server's real response: refused
unique index, staged increments, the rolled-back commit, re-read
production paths refuse demo programs · demo time moves only this sandbox's
deadlines, never a clock · at most 10 active sandboxes per network · reset deletes
the old generation · idle for 24 h → removed with its Team
Measured on the deployed Functions: first open 8–17 s, freeze 3–10 s, completing draw call 12–23 s, rollback 2–3 s, 48 h fast-forward 7 s (synchronous executions
are capped at 30 s, so the page calls again until done).
